monster1.prompt_en: Humanoid avian-reptilian monster with a powerful muscular build; spiky pale feathered crest running along the top of its head; sharp angular avian face with dark narrow predatory eyes and a beak-like jaw; dark muscular torso; dark muscular lower limbs with pale feathered accents; two massive, multi-layered feathered wings extending from its back; sharp talons on hands and feet.
monster1.prompt_ch: 具有强壮肌肉体格的人形鸟爬行类怪物；头顶有尖锐的浅色羽毛冠；尖锐的棱角分明的鸟类面孔，有着深色狭长的掠食性眼睛和类似喙的下颌；深色肌肉发达的躯干；深色肌肉发达的下肢，带有浅色羽毛点缀；背后长有两只巨大的多层羽毛翅膀；手和脚上有锋利的爪子。

girl1.prompt_en: Young teenage female with a slender build; long straight dark hair with straight textured bangs and sidelocks reaching past her shoulders; fair complexion with large expressive dark eyes, wearing dark-framed oval eyeglasses; dark and grey horizontally striped turtleneck long-sleeved sweater; light-colored miniskirt; black full-length leggings; dark low-top sneakers.
girl1.prompt_ch: 身材纤细的年轻十几岁女孩；黑色长直发，留有带纹理的齐刘海和长过肩膀的侧边发；肤色白皙，眼睛又大又黑且充满神采，戴着黑框椭圆形眼镜；身穿深灰色横条纹高领长袖毛衣；浅色迷你裙；黑色全长紧身裤；深色低帮运动鞋。

Plot Correspondence.en: In a bustling urban plaza, girl1 gazes up at a large electronic billboard displaying a popular idol.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 在一个熙熙攘攘的城市广场上，girl1抬头看着一块正在播放流行偶像画面的大型电子广告牌。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. Bright natural daylight across a wide urban paved plaza outside a multistory commercial building with glass windows and structural pillars. Centered on the building facade above the ground floor entrance is one large rectangular electronic billboard screen. Beneath the billboard, two square vertical pillars frame a glass entranceway. The plaza ground is paved with grid-patterned tiles. To the left and background, approximately seven pedestrians are distributed across the plaza. On the far right, one adult male pedestrian stands on the pavement.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。明亮的自然日光照亮了一栋带有玻璃窗和结构柱的多层商业建筑外的宽阔城市铺砌广场。建筑立面一楼入口上方中央是一块巨大的长方形电子广告牌屏幕。广告牌下方，两根方形立柱构成了一个玻璃入口。广场地面铺有网格状地砖。在左侧和背景中，大约有七名行人分布在广场上。在最右侧，一名成年男性行人站在路面上。

Shot Perspective Design.en: Wide establishing shot from a low-to-eye level perspective.
Shot Perspective Design.ch: 远景交代镜头，从低角度到平视的视角。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 stands on the right side of the screen in the foreground with her back facing the camera, gazing up toward the electronic screen. On the far right of the screen, an adult male pedestrian wearing a flat cap, glasses, and a light jacket stands facing forward toward the camera with his hands in his pockets. In the upper-left and center of the frame, the large electronic screen displays a twin-tailed pop idol performing with a handheld microphone.
Static Shot Description.ch: girl1背对镜头站在画面右侧前景，抬头注视着电子屏幕。画面最右侧，一名戴着鸭舌帽和眼镜、身穿浅色夹克的成年男性行人双手插兜，面朝镜头站立。在画面左上方和中央，巨大的电子屏幕上播放着一位双马尾流行偶像手持麦克风表演的画面。

Plot Correspondence.en: Feeling weary and resigned, girl1 adjusts her glasses, lamenting that her life will never dramatically change.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 感到疲惫和无奈的girl1扶了扶眼镜，感叹自己的人生永远不会发生什么惊天动地的变化。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. Soft ambient outdoor daylight with a subtle neutral urban background tone providing consistent environmental lighting.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。柔和的室外环境日光，带有微妙的中性城市背景色调，提供一致的环境照明。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 is centered in the frame, with her head angled slightly toward screen right and slightly bowed, eyes closed in a weary, resigned expression. She raises both hands to hold the temples of a pair of dark-rimmed round spectacles at the sides of her head as she slips them into place over the bridge of her nose.
Static Shot Description.ch: girl1位于画面中央，头部稍微向画面右侧倾斜并略微低垂，闭着眼睛，表情疲惫且无可奈何。她举起双手捏住戴在头侧的一副黑框圆眼镜的镜腿，将其滑落佩戴在鼻梁上。

Plot Correspondence.en: Suddenly, the massive electronic screen above violently shatters, causing panic among the pedestrians while girl1 freezes in surprise.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 突然，上方巨大的电子屏幕猛烈碎裂，引起行人们的恐慌，而girl1则惊讶地呆立在原地。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. The outdoor plaza directly in front of the commercial building entrance. Above girl1, the large electronic screen shatters into numerous falling glass shards and debris. In the background, two square building pillars stand behind her, flanked by two fleeing pedestrians on the left and two fleeing pedestrians on the right.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。商业建筑入口正前方的室外广场。在girl1上方，巨大的电子屏幕碎裂成无数落下的玻璃碎片和碎块。在背景中，她身后矗立着两根方形建筑柱子，左侧有两名逃跑的行人，右侧也有两名逃跑的行人。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 is positioned in the center of the frame facing the camera, wearing a pair of dark round spectacles over her wide, startled eyes. Her mouth is slightly open and she raises both hands into loose fists beside her cheeks in surprise. Directly above her, numerous sharp glass shards and debris burst outward and rain down. In the background on the left, two pedestrians recoil, while two pedestrians on the right turn to flee.
Static Shot Description.ch: girl1位于画面中央，面朝镜头，戴着一副深色圆眼镜，双眼因惊吓而睁大。她嘴巴微张，惊讶地将双手半握拳举在脸颊旁。在她正上方，大量锋利的玻璃碎片和残骸向外爆裂并如雨点般落下。在左侧背景中，两名行人向后退缩，而右侧的两名行人则转身逃跑。

Plot Correspondence.en: A terrifying avian monster emerges from the shattered billboard, glaring down menacingly from the broken ledge.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 一只可怕的鸟类怪物从破碎的广告牌中出现，从破损的边缘充满威胁地向下瞪视。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. The ruined upper ledge of the electronic billboard on the commercial building facade. In an inset on the right side of the frame, several severed electrical cables and wires hang down with bright electrical sparks crackling from the broken wire ends, surrounded by plumes of dust, smoke, and falling sharp glass fragments.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。商业建筑立面上电子广告牌被毁坏的上边缘。在画面右侧，几根断裂的电缆和电线垂下，从断裂的线头爆发出明亮的电火花，周围环绕着灰尘、烟雾和飘落的锋利玻璃碎片。

Static Shot Description.en: monster1 crouches aggressively in the center of the frame on the broken rectangular ledge of the billboard. monster1 glares down menacingly toward the camera with dark, narrow predatory eyes, gripping the ledge with sharp taloned feet while spreading its two massive, multi-layered feathered wings wide across the upper screen.
Static Shot Description.ch: monster1以充满攻击性的姿态蹲在画面中央破损的广告牌长方形边缘上。monster1用深色狭长且充满掠食性的眼睛恶狠狠地向镜头下方瞪视，用锋利的爪脚紧紧抓住边缘，同时将它那对巨大的多层羽毛翅膀在画面上方宽宽地展开。

Plot Correspondence.en: Overcome with sheer terror and disbelief, girl1 stammers out in panic at the monstrous threat before her.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 被极度的恐惧和难以置信所压倒，girl1在眼前的怪物威胁下惊慌失措地结巴起来。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. High-contrast ambient outdoor lighting with a bright neutral background framing the character to emphasize psychological shock and panic.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。高对比度的室外环境光，明亮的中性背景框住人物，以强调心理上的震惊和恐慌。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 is centered in the frame, facing forward and looking slightly upward toward screen right. She wears a pair of dark round spectacles over her wide, terrified eyes, with cold sweat streaming down her cheeks and forehead and her mouth open in shock. She reaches her left hand forward toward the camera with trembling fingers.
Static Shot Description.ch: girl1位于画面中央，面向前方，视线略微向画面右上方看去。她戴着一副深色圆眼镜，双眼因恐惧而睁大，冷汗顺着脸颊和额头流下，嘴巴因震惊而张开。她伸出左手朝向镜头，手指微微颤抖。

Plot Correspondence.en: The monster crashes violently onto the plaza floor, destroying the pavement while girl1 desperately tries to back away.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 怪物猛烈地砸在广场地面上，摧毁了路面，而girl1拼命试图后退。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. The outdoor plaza outside multistory city office buildings. The paved tile ground on the right side of the screen is heavily fractured into jagged stone chunks and clouds of impact dust. In the far left background, a multistory office building with multiple rows of rectangular windows stands tall, with four small pedestrian silhouettes fleeing across the street.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。多层城市办公大楼外的室外广场。画面右侧铺砌的瓷砖地面严重断裂成锯齿状的碎石块并扬起撞击产生的尘云。在最左侧的背景中，一栋有着多排矩形窗户的多层办公大楼高高耸立，四个微小的行人剪影正跑过街道。

Shot Perspective Design.en: Dynamic wide low-angle shot with a tilted Dutch angle.
Shot Perspective Design.ch: 带有倾斜荷兰角的动态广角低角度镜头。

Static Shot Description.en: On the right side of the screen, monster1 slams violently into the paved ground in a heavy three-point landing with its wings flared back, sending a massive shockwave of shattered pavement and dust blasting into the air. In the center-left midground, girl1 wears a pair of dark round spectacles, turning and stumbling back toward screen left with wide, terrified eyes. In the lower-left background, four pedestrians run away in panic toward the surrounding city buildings.
Static Shot Description.ch: 在画面右侧，monster1猛烈地砸向铺砌的地面，以沉重的三点着陆姿势落地，翅膀向后展开，激起巨大的碎裂路面和灰尘的冲击波冲向空中。在左中景处，戴着一副深色圆眼镜的girl1转身跌跌撞撞地向画面左侧退去，双眼因恐惧而睁大。在左下方的背景中，四名行人惊慌失措地向周围的城市建筑逃跑。
